Usage notes:
  - Use this to terminate a background process that was started in the background (timeout=0).

kill_shellReads output from a running terminal process that was started in the background (timeout=0).
Usage notes:
  - Use this to check on the output of background processes.
  - The terminal_id is the ID returned when you started the command in the background (timeout=0).
  - If the process has already exited, this will return any remaining output.
  - You can specify an optional timeout in milliseconds to wait for new output.
